prompts.dan:
Use case: identity-preserve.
Asset type: production animation pose atlas for a 2D paper-cutout sports game.
Input image 1 is the Dan identity and drawing-style reference. Extract and reinterpret the man from the card as SIX complete full-body poses of the SAME adult man with the SAME face and outfit. Do not reproduce the card layout.
Canvas: square 2048 x 2048 preferred, at least 1536 x 1536. Exactly 3 equal columns by 2 equal rows. Six isolated fullbody figures, each centered within its cell with broad transparent gutters between cells, no dividing lines or cell labels. All six figures the same scale; feet grounded at the same baseline within each row. Leave generous empty headroom so raised arms are not cropped. Every foot, fingertip and head must fit fully within its cell.
Identity: recognizable Dan from the reference, tousled medium brown hair, natural stubbled beard, realistic illustrated face and adult anatomical proportions about seven to eight heads tall. White pizza mascot T-shirt, with the reference Pepperoni Cheesers print, black knee-length athletic shorts, black flip-flops. No costume variations between frames.
Six poses in exact reading order: TOP LEFT neutral relaxed sport-ready stance facing right in three-quarter view, hands EMPTY. TOP MIDDLE underarm throwing backswing with throwing arm behind the hip, EMPTY hand. TOP RIGHT underarm release, throwing arm reaching forward toward the right, EMPTY open hand. BOTTOM LEFT overarm football-throw preparation, elbow raised and EMPTY throwing hand cocked beside and behind the head, nonthrowing hand forward. BOTTOM MIDDLE overhead basketball shooting follow-through with both EMPTY hands raised, natural wrists and fingers, feet grounded. BOTTOM RIGHT celebratory fist raised, happy expression, feet grounded.
Rendering: realistic sports collectible-card ink illustration matching the reference: dimensional human anatomy made with confident black ink lines, detailed faces, rich warm skin, fabric folds, hatching and screenprinted color texture. Flat 2D paper cutout asset, slight warm offwhite die-cut border around the WHOLE silhouette of each figure. No toy look, no cute simplification, no big heads, no chibi, no bobbleheads, no 3D puppet or plastic rendering.
Genuinely transparent background with alpha. No ground, no shadow, no scene, no motion effects, no lettering outside the T-shirt, no grid lines. Absolutely NO balls, beanbags, cups or other handheld objects: all hands empty. No overlapping figures. Preserve identity and outfit in every pose.

prompts.arena:
Use case: style-transfer.
Asset type: background scenery layer for a 2D paper-cutout sports game.
Input images are drawing-style and mood references only. Create a new wide 16:9 landscape arena illustration at 1920 x 1080 or greater. This is an EMPTY sports playing stage with illustrated spectator scenery behind it.
Scene: a timber backyard sports club arena at orange sunset. Wide shallow side/three-quarter view. Warm gray flat asphalt fills the bottom 45 percent of the entire composition, clean and empty with only subtle printed paper/asphalt grain. The playing surface must be a broad nearly horizontal stage, not a steep perspective corridor. Timber fence and small cheering spectator crowd sit at the horizon around 45 percent of image height; crowd stays strictly behind the fence, never in foreground. Mustard-yellow plywood bleachers, wood posts and string lights form the backdrop. Upper central area has one large clean plain BLACK rectangular scoreboard suspended from timber supports, absolutely EMPTY with no numbers, lettering, icons or markings inside. Leave the scoreboard dark blank so game UI can overlay it.
Visual style: sports collectible-card illustration and cut-paper sports zine diorama matching the reference cards. Orange sunset sky, strong black ink contours, halftone distress, teal accents, mustard wood panels, cream paper edges. Adult realistic illustrated crowd faces, controlled gritty screenprint textures, vivid warm sports-event energy, shallow dimensional paper layers. Subtle cream cut edges on major scenery silhouettes. No soft cute cartoon design, no toy-like rendering.
Constraints: no foreground characters, no cornhole boards, no basketball hoops, no cups, no balls, no loose game props; these are drawn separately by the game. No words or digits anywhere. No purple, no fantasy, no neon, no trophy palace. No card border. The lower 45 percent must remain empty, broad, level playable asphalt.
